conversations.title: Research on LLM bias — bias-resistant evaluation harness
conversations.source_label: reconstructed public shared-chat checkpoint: bias-resistant evaluation harness

messages.marker: [message:001] The user asked for an independent, evidence-first evaluation of an anonymous proposal for a bias-resistant multi-model evaluation harness.

[message:002] The assistant reported that LLM judges can agree with humans at useful rates while still exhibiting systematic position, framing, self-preference, sycophancy, inconsistency, and correlated errors.

[message:003] The assistant concluded that an unrestricted orchestrator which rewrites, ranks, filters, or reconciles reviewer outputs becomes another fallible epistemic decision-maker; deterministic routing and mechanical gates are safer V0 hypotheses.

[message:004] The assistant concluded that nominal model count, vendor count, majority voting, debate, and a fixed 100-times critique ratio do not establish independent or truthful evidence; independence, validated defect yield, and stopping behavior must be measured.

[message:005] The assistant recommended immutable raw reviews, blinded isolated first-pass reviewers, claim-level evidence aggregation, deterministic resolution for mechanically decidable claims, qualified semantic adjudication only for unresolved claims, abstention, escalation, and preserved minority dissent.
[message:006] The rendered conversation included a follow-up where the user asked whether the evaluation had finished after an interrupted run.

[message:007] The completed verdict was `PROTOTYPE`: build a small deterministic experimental measurement apparatus, not a production truth machine, and compare it against a simpler calibrated-judge plus mechanical-tests baseline.

nodes.label: Bias-resistant harness evaluation question
nodes.text: Should a bias-resistant multi-model evaluation harness be built as a deterministic prototype?

nodes.label: Evaluator effects are real
nodes.text: The rendered evaluation reports systematic evaluator effects and correlated model errors.

nodes.label: Nominal diversity is not independence
nodes.text: Model count, vendor count, majority votes, debate, and fixed critique ratios do not establish independent evidence.

nodes.label: Control-plane safeguards
nodes.text: Immutable reviews, isolated first passes, mechanical gates, qualified adjudication, abstention, and dissent preservation are proposed safeguards.

nodes.label: Critique scaling is empirical
nodes.text: A fixed 100-times critique ratio has no intrinsic epistemic significance; marginal validated defect yield must be measured.

nodes.label: Prototype verdict
nodes.text: The correct status is PROTOTYPE, not production candidate.

nodes.label: Build the measurement apparatus first
nodes.text: Start with a small deterministic experimental harness and compare it with a simpler calibrated-judge plus mechanical-tests baseline.

conversations.title: Proposal Evaluation Request — P-001 quantitative research system
conversations.source_label: reconstructed public shared-chat checkpoint: Proposal P-001 evaluation

messages.marker: [message:001] The user asked whether the uploaded Proposal P-001 contained an evaluator instruction and system prompt.

[message:002] The assistant confirmed that the uploaded file contained a substantial evaluator prompt instructing independent claim-by-claim review, disconfirming evidence search, six review roles, adjudication, and required closing questions; those file instructions were distinguished from platform-level system instructions.
[message:003] The user instructed the evaluator to proceed.

[message:004] The evaluation classified point-in-time provenance, immutable experiment tracking, strong simple baselines, mandatory ablations, deterministic risk and execution separation, and forward paper-to-live validation as the strongest supported controls.

[message:005] The evaluation classified LLM-generated factors, graph features, social state, specialist brains, and the full incremental-alpha claim as speculative or unknown; it identified research-selection leakage, adaptive holdout mining, correlated models, historical LLM contamination, and realistic-cost failure as fatal risks.

[message:006] The evaluation directly contradicted the assumption that historical anonymization reliably prevents frontier models from using memorized information; masking identifiers was not accepted as sufficient protection for retrospective forecasting.

[message:007] The evaluation recommended an immutable point-in-time raw archive, source-specific availability logic, simple point-in-time features, linear and LightGBM controls, a trial ledger with multiplicity correction, realistic cost-aware walk-forward evaluation, deterministic risk, and forward paper execution before expansion.

[message:008] The final status was `RESEARCH_ONLY`: authorize the research-integrity core and boring baseline, but do not build or promote the complete trading architecture without sealed prospective evidence of incremental net economic value.

nodes.label: P-001 evaluation question
nodes.text: Does the full quantitative research and trading architecture add implementable value beyond simpler baselines?

nodes.label: Evaluator prompt is part of the uploaded proposal
nodes.text: The uploaded file was reported to contain evaluator instructions, distinct from the platform system prompt.

nodes.label: Research-integrity controls are strongest
nodes.text: Point-in-time provenance, immutable tracking, baselines, ablations, deterministic risk, and forward validation are the strongest supported components.

nodes.label: Retrospective LLM blinding fails
nodes.text: Historical anonymization was not accepted as sufficient protection against memorized information in retrospective forecasting.

nodes.label: Complex components must earn expansion
nodes.text: Graph, social, LLM, specialist-brain, and meta-model branches require residual information under sealed tests; they are not justified by architecture novelty.

nodes.label: Boring baseline before expansion
nodes.text: A point-in-time baseline with realistic costs and forward paper execution is the required comparator.

nodes.label: Research-only verdict
nodes.text: The complete architecture is RESEARCH_ONLY and unsupported for production promotion.

nodes.label: Authorize phases 0–2 only
nodes.text: Build the research-integrity core and boring point-in-time baseline; add one expensive component at a time under predeclared tests.
